title: SF424 (R & R)
description: SF 424 (R&R) (RR_SF424_5_0) is the Application for Federal Assistance used for Research and Related programs. It collects submission type, applicant organization information, contact person details, employer identification, applicant type, application type with revision codes, federal agency and assistance listing info, project title and period, congressional district, PD/PI contact information, estimated funding, state review status, certifications, authorized representative details, and optional attachments.
notes: Plan-first review proposal for FID768 v5.0; no compiled form or renderer implementation is included. Corrected source paths use GlobalLibrary-V2.0 OrganizationInfo/Department and Division.

Contact-person email is optional in both DAT05-9 and XSD. PD/PI and AOR emails are required. AOR title is required; contact-person and PD/PI titles are optional. Shared contact/name/address questions must preserve these role-specific constraints.

DAT radio option rows belong to their named Radio Group answer; they are not independent applicant fields. Revision DAT08-1-1…08-1-5 are five checkboxes contributing to one RevisionCode answer, with explicit choice-to-code bindings. XSD permits A, B, C, D, E, AC, AD, BC, BD; the combination/activation behavior is an implementation obligation, not five independent YesNo XML elements.

For all four address roles, Country=USA requires State and ZIP. Preserve the DAT US ZIP minLength9 rule in addition to XSD minLength1/maxLength30. Province is optional and enabled for non-US countries; activation is not requiredness. Country defaults are role-specific DAT population rules, not a reason to erase a supplied value.

Submitted/received dates, federal identifier, previous tracking identifier, applicant-type Other explanation, revision Other explanation, other-agency explanation and state-review date retain their DAT ownership and conditional rules. Start date must not follow end date.

The four required funding amounts use the exact XSD BudgetTotalAmountDataType bounds and precision. DAT15-3 asks the applicant to enter the combined total; it does not mark that field calculated/read-only. Any proposed auto-calculation or consistency validation must be reviewed rather than silently changing its ownership.

DAT19-14 and19-15 are bound post-populated labels: signature and signed date remain required wire values supplied by submission/signing, not editable applicant text/date controls. AOR_Signature maxLength144 comes from both DAT and XSD, correcting the earlier45-character draft.

The imported OrganizationDataTypeV5 includes optional OrganizationInfo/EIN, but this form DAT/PDF asks for EIN/TIN only once at06-0, mapped to root EmployerID. Proposed plan omits the unused optional imported EIN slot rather than collecting a second tax identifier; record the source discrepancy and review this choice.

SmallBusinessOrganizationType is optional and nillable in XSD. Nillability permits XML nil but does not require JSON null. Propose omitting the inactive container when ApplicantType is not Small Business; preserve the two distinct eligibility answers when active.

The three attachments remain distinct purposes: lobbying/explanatory documentation, pre-application and cover letter. Reuse upload capture without inventing document-service IDs or conflating the answers. Confirm source conditions and ownership during implementation.

SubmissionTypeCode uses the exact XSD code "Change/Corrected Application", while the DAT/PDF display label spells "Changed/Corrected Application". Preserve the source display-to-code distinction. DAT01-1…01-3 require the previous tracking ID for a correction and limit post-deadline changes to agency requests.

DAT08-0 option help distinguishes New (first submission), Resubmission (previously unfunded), Renewal (competing subsequent award period), Continuation (non-competing additional period) and Revision (change to an existing award). They are five options of one answer, not independent booleans.

DAT16-2/16-5/16-6 are three state-review radio options. Preserve the agency-announcement/SPOC instructions with the covered-program option and condition the review date on Y: Yes. Static tests compare optionality but do not decide whether a particular program is covered.
risks: Review the optional imported OrganizationInfo/EIN disposition and the revision checkbox-to-enum proposal before implementation.

Conditional-requiredness, inactive-field clearing/omission, US ZIP behavior, start/end ordering, funding consistency and affirmative certification need executable tests in the later form-definition work.
The maintained harness validates static source correspondence; it does not implement the checkbox combinations, attachment service, submission signature/date population or XML emission.
Proposed JSON paths describe the plan; canonical emitted schema and source-code reuse are established only after the form definition and question selection are compiled/reviewed.
